title: Customer Service Team Leader
summary: A customer service team leader runs a team of about 10 to 20 voice, chat or email agents in a BPO or in-house contact centre and owns its handle time, satisfaction (CSAT) and first-contact resolution numbers. The role reports to an operations manager and coaches agents, manages rosters and takes escalated calls.
dailyDuties: Run start-of-shift huddles and share targets with agents
Monitor live calls or chats and coach agents one-on-one
Track AHT, CSAT, FCR and roster adherence through the day
Take escalated calls from unhappy customers
Plan rosters, leaves and breaks to keep shrinkage in limits
Review agent scorecards and run improvement plans
Send daily and weekly team MIS to the operations manager

skills.expectation: Own the team's AHT, CSAT, FCR and service-level targets
Manage rosters, login hours, breaks and shrinkage with the workforce team
Listen to calls or chats, give feedback and coach agents one-on-one
Run agent scorecards, reviews and improvement plans for a team of 10 to 20
Take escalated calls and close complaints the agents could not resolve
Know the voice, chat or email process the team works on
Build daily and weekly team MIS and dashboards in Excel
Lead, motivate and hold a frontline team accountable
Run team huddles and explain results to managers and clients
Use the CRM to review customer history and case notes
Track open tickets and backlog in the help desk tool
Find the cause of repeat calls and low scores
Run team engagement activities to keep attrition down
Deliver refresher and process-update sessions to agents
